# Edit apps only inside a task

`S0.3` · Coding rule

Repos change only inside an explicit task. Audits and planning are read-only. Never commit, push, merge or deploy unless the user asks in that task.

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-shared|Rules for all code]].
